task_description: Add an interactive 3D graph to the StockDetail page showing PnL vs Time vs OI when viewing a trade. Users can rotate, pan, and zoom the 3D visualization using orbit controls.

verification.summary: tsc -b passes with no errors, vite build produces a working bundle. No test suite exists in this project. Review issues (axis mapping, zero-plane, closed-trade capping) have been addressed.
